text:
maria: FYI - Azure Marketplace security review came back with a tight artifact list. They want SOC 2 Type II, a recent penetration test (scoped to marketplace endpoints), SBOM, and our completed vendor questionnaire. Deadline: May 12.

alex: Ugh. Our last pen test was Oct 2024 and it focused on internal infra, not the marketplace integration. We should confirm scope. Who owns getting a scoped pen-test quote? :thinking_face:

jordan: I can loop in our pentest vendor (RedTeamX). They usually turn around a summary in 2 weeks. Need to confirm if Azure requires attestation or full report.

maria: They accept either a redacted full report + attestation letter. They specifically called out: vulnerability verification steps and remediation timeline.

samir: Quick checklist I sketched for artifacts (will upload to S3):
```
- SOC2_TypeII_2024_Redwood_redacted.pdf
- pentest_marketplace_summary_2025-04.pdf
- sbom-marketplace.json
- dpa_signed_redwood.pdf
- marketplace_security_questionnaire_answers.xlsx
```

alex: For SBOM — do we need CycloneDX or SPDX? Azure's docs prefer CycloneDX. I'll convert and add sha256 fingerprints.

maria: @sophia can you confirm legal DPA language for marketplace listing? Also need signature scan for any 3P libs in SBOM flagged as restricted.

sophia: On it. I'll review the DPA and the questionnaire answers. If RedTeamX needs an NDA for report redaction, we can sign the partner NDA — ping me the vendor contact.

compliance-bot: Reminder: marketplace submission window opens in 9 business days. Please attach artifacts to the secure intake link: https://verify.redwood.com/marketplace-intake (use SSO). :calendar:

jordan: Sharing vendor contact: redteamx@redteamx.io. I asked for an initial scoping ETA of 48h. Budgetwise, should we route through procurement or treat as one-off professional services?

maria: Route through procurement for >$10k. Jordan, if estimate >10k, copy procurement. If <10k, samir can create a P-card request.

alex: One more item - Azure asked for a timeline for addressing critical vuln findings. We should draft a standard 30/60/90 remediation SLA to include in the submission. I'll prepare a short bullet doc.

samir: I'll prepare a zipped package and upload to the intake link once we have the redacted pentest and SOC2 redactions done. Expect upload by May 10 if vendors and legal turn fast.

maria: Great. Owners: Pen-test = jordan, SOC2 redaction = alex, SBOM + fingerprints = alex, Legal signoff = sophia, Package upload = samir. I’ll own submission comms with Azure PM.

sophia: Noted. Also confirming: we should include contact for security escalation (security@redwood.com) and our SOC2 auditor attestation letter.

alex: I'll draft the remediation SLA and the attestation note. Sharing draft in this thread later today.

maria: Awesome — thanks team. If anything stalls, flag here. :thumbsup:

jordan: RedTeamX replied — preliminary scope PDF incoming. Forwarding here when received.

maria: Filing this as action items in the marketplace folder. Thanks everyone.
